headline: Using only facts known before an anime airs, a linear model explains about 43% of the variation in MyAnimeList score on titles it has not seen (5-fold cross-validated R squared 0.43, versus 0.00 for always predicting the mean). No single factor has a large effect on its own: the biggest is medium. The strongest are studio (effect size 0.107, medium), source material (0.104, medium), and content rating (0.075, medium). These are associations in observational data, not causes.
